user_story: A group of researchers is using abstractive summarization to identify key trends and insights in large sets of biological data, enabling more efficient analysis and interpretation.
As a social worker, I want to use neural gas to analyze and classify social work data, such as client needs and service utilization, so that I can improve social work practice and service delivery.
As a librarian, I want to use artificial neural networks to analyze user behavior and improve library services, so that we can provide a better experience for our patrons.
